critique.evidence: Desktop is visually strong: the oversized headline, restrained grid, cyan/red semantic palette, ledger alignment, and circular ROI focal point create a coherent, polished hierarchy. Mobile preserves the core look, but the ledger becomes cramped—long currency values nearly collide and several labels wrap awkwardly. Tablet is the decisive failure: the horizontal navigation bar overlays and obscures the headline and supporting copy, producing a visibly broken composition. The tablet/mobile layouts also become very tall and lose the balanced desktop relationship between ledger and ROI panel.
critique.fix: Correct the tablet header behavior so navigation occupies reserved space and never overlays page content; switch to a compact menu before links overflow. Rework narrow ledger rows with more deliberate column widths, smaller numeric type, or stacked label/value groups so long amounts retain spacing. Tighten the vertical rhythm of the stacked ROI section while preserving the desktop hierarchy.
